gate_a.accuracy_of: the smaller of the two published extrapolants, on which the bound L rests; the published range [smaller, larger] is reported with its bracket coverage
gate_a.matching: validation cells of the same dataset and map type, with the same status, whose median d(R_h,max) and fall are both within 0.05 of the real cell's; the dependent-noise (D) and stress (S) cells are diagnostics and never match
gate_a.criterion: every matching cell must meet the accuracy criterion (the worst matching cell decides)
gate_a.readings: two classifications are reported: strict (Section 3.5: no candidate qualified, so every latent estimate is model-dependent) and local (Section 5, cell by cell); the author chooses at Gate A
gate_a.layer_c: under the local reading, for real cells classified estimable with their matching cells accurate; the guard in the first 200 studies only, as the timing check projects over 6 h per scenario with it
